projectDescription: A semantic and ontology layer that standardizes, enriches, and connects banking data concepts—enabling consistent definitions, relationships, and intelligent querying across financial systems.
keyFeatures: Canonical banking entity definitions (customers, accounts, transactions, products)
Ontology-driven relationship mapping across financial data sources
Taxonomy management for regulatory and compliance classifications
Semantic query engine for natural-language and SPARQL-style queries
Integration connectors for core banking systems and data warehouses
Rules engine for business logic and data governance
Audit trail and lineage tracking for compliance
publicApiSurface: GET /entities — list all canonical entity types
GET /entities/{id} — retrieve entity definition and attributes
GET /relationships — list semantic relationships between entities
POST /query — execute semantic queries against the ontology
POST /enrich — enrich raw banking records against the semantic model
GET /taxonomies/{id}/terms — list terms within a taxonomy
POST /mappings — define field mappings from source systems
GET /lineage/{entityId} — retrieve data lineage for an entity
